core_protocols.title: 0.1 Genesis Gold® dosing and use
core_protocols.text:
- **Dose:** 4 grams per 50 lb of body weight = one-third of the large scoop per 50 lb. One full scoop (12 g) is the dose for a 150 lb person. Example: 190–200 lb → about 1¼–1⅓ scoops; 120 lb → about ¾ scoop.
- **Which weight:** dose by *ideal* body weight if the person is underweight or has lost a lot of weight; if morbidly obese, dose by the weight that would put them in the "overweight" (not obese) range for their height.
- **Children:** body-weight dosing; historically mixed into yogurt or applesauce.
- **Timing:** first thing in the morning on an empty stomach. Wait at least 15 minutes (30 is better) before anything with calories. Non-caloric drinks, coffee or tea are fine.
- **Mixing:** water is first choice. Coconut water if there is acid reflux/GERD or stomach acidity (it neutralizes the citric acid used for flavor); a splash of juice or lemon helps sensitive taste buds. Avoid milk, milkshakes or thick smoothies — they slow stomach emptying and absorption.
- **Starting slowly (sensitive, multiple autoimmune, hypersensitive):** ⅓ of body-weight dose for week 1, ⅔ for week 2, full dose from week 3. Graduating up is fine for anyone.
- **What's in it / not in it:** ~80 ingredients — Sacred Seven amino acids at a moderate dose, sea vegetation, sprouted ancient grains, botanicals/adaptogens (micro-dosed), digestive aids, low-dose broad-spectrum probiotics. No animal products, no added (synthetic) vitamins or minerals, no hormones. It does **not** provide vitamin D3 or fish-oil EPA/DHA in meaningful amounts.
- **Purity:** every ingredient is tested (certificates of analysis) for heavy metals, pesticides, bacterial and fungal contamination before blending, and the finished batch is tested again. Some ingredients are organic; wildcrafted botanicals and sea vegetation can't be certified organic, so the product as a whole isn't labeled organic.
- **Where to buy:** genesisgold.com only — not on Amazon.

core_protocols.title: 0.2 Sacred Seven® dosing and use
core_protocols.text:
- **Adults:** one 5-gram scoop daily, mixed with water (can be stirred into Genesis Gold).
- **Children:** under 50 lb → about ¼ scoop; 50–100 lb → ½ to ⅔ scoop.
- **Use Sacred Seven alone (instead of Genesis Gold) when:** gut is out of balance (SIBO, Candida, dysbiosis, bloating/gas on Genesis Gold); allergy to a plant ingredient in Genesis Gold; Graves' disease; mast cell activation syndrome (first 3 months).
- **Add Sacred Seven on top of Genesis Gold when:** symptoms are severe or long-standing (years); severe hot flashes/night sweats; severe insomnia; high autoimmune antibodies; weaning off antidepressants/anti-anxiety medication; dementia, memory or learning issues; traumatic brain injury; high-stress periods; GLP-1 weight loss; mood or depression that persists after ~30 days on Genesis Gold.

core_protocols.title: 0.3 Healing timeline (the rule Deborah uses everywhere)
core_protocols.text:
- **Foundation:** at least **90 days** for the hypothalamic–pituitary–gland communication to recalibrate.
- **Add one month for every year** the person has been out of balance (e.g., 10 years → 90 days + 10 months).
- **What to expect when:** energy and sleep often improve in 1–4 weeks; a "rebound" of symptoms (more hot flashes, sweating, sleep disruption) in the first 1–4 weeks is common and passes; periods in hypothalamic amenorrhea often return in 6–12 weeks; skin ~2 months, hair 3–4 months (shedding of old hair and short new "vellus" hairs come first), nails vary. Autoimmune antibodies typically take 12–18 months to fall.
- **Order of healing:** the hypothalamus heals vital organs first (heart, brain, kidneys, liver, vessels), then endocrine, immune and nervous systems, then gut, and skin/hair/nails last.
- **Maintenance:** many people eventually take less than full body-weight dose; increase temporarily during stress. Take a 3–7 day break after 6+ months of continuous use, about twice a year (Deborah: after the holidays and in summer); a break can be paired with her liver cleanse.

core_protocols.title: 0.4 Cautions & contraindications
core_protocols.text:
- **Warfarin/Coumadin:** Genesis Gold is very green (vitamin K). Not forbidden, but start very slowly and have clotting levels monitored.
- **Graves' disease (autoimmune hyperthyroidism):** use Sacred Seven only — the iodine-rich sea vegetation in Genesis Gold can raise thyroid hormone. Genesis Gold may be added once the thyroid is balanced.
- **SIBO, Candida overgrowth, dysbiosis:** Genesis Gold feeds the microbes too ("fertilizing the flowers and the weeds"). Start with Sacred Seven, treat the gut, then add Genesis Gold.
- **Herpes simplex (oral or genital) outbreaks:** Sacred Seven contains arginine. Add L-lysine 250–500 mg, or use Genesis Gold (more diluted amino acids) instead.
- **Mast cell activation syndrome:** Sacred Seven for ~3 months before slowly adding Genesis Gold.
- **Other medications:** Deborah has seen no problems with heart, neurological or cancer medications, thyroid hormone, hydrocortisone, SSRIs, LDN, or HRT. Keep all prescriptions; changes are made with the prescribing provider.
- **Berberine** (recommended separately for insulin resistance): not for pregnancy, breastfeeding, children, or people with liver or kidney disease.
- **Ashwagandha:** high doses can strain the liver; Genesis Gold contains a micro-dose (100 mg per 12 g scoop).

core_protocols.title: 0.5 Red flags — tell the user to see a provider promptly
core_protocols.text:
- Any bleeding after menopause → pelvic ultrasound (endometrial stripe), and endometrial biopsy if indicated.
- Fainting episodes.
- Severe or persistent diarrhea with dehydration, "wobbliness" or dizziness → chemistry panel/electrolytes.
- FSH over 30 in a woman under 40 → evaluate for premature ovarian insufficiency (AMH test).
- High prolactin with headaches or milky nipple discharge → evaluate for pituitary adenoma.
- Thickened endometrial lining on ultrasound → biopsy before any hormonal changes.
- Chest pain or symptoms that could be cardiac should never be assumed to be "just hormones."

entries.title: Why deep, early sleep matters (growth hormone)
entries.deborahs_guidance: Growth hormone pulses right after you fall asleep and again in the middle of the night; the second pulse depends on the first. Trouble falling asleep blunts both, limiting tissue repair and healing. Sleep in darkness, have a bedtime routine, get off screens after dusk, and do whatever helps you fall asleep promptly (boring book, meditation, sounds).

entries.deborahs_guidance: The sympathetic system revs you up; the parasympathetic (via the vagus nerve) calms you. Deep breathing works but we forget to do it under stress. Humming vibrates the vocal cords and stimulates the vagus nerve. Pick a "happy song" and hum for 5 minutes daily, and whenever anxious. Deborah hums the lullaby she sang while breastfeeding — her body associates it with oxytocin. See LIFE-01.

entries.title: Is stress connected to allergies?
entries.deborahs_guidance: Yes. Real or imagined stress triggers the autonomic response (adrenaline), then the hypothalamus calls for cortisol to release stored sugar. Chronically high cortisol eventually overwhelms receptors and can trigger histamine reactions (hives, rashes, food reactivity, sinus congestion). True allergies also stress the HPA axis, so the two feed each other. Train the parasympathetic system: breathe in for 4, hold for 4, exhale slowly for 6–8; pair it with a scent (e.g., lavender) or a hummable song so the cue alone triggers GABA. Stay on Genesis Gold; add Sacred Seven under heavy stress. Calm can be trained, like first responders learn.

Go slowly with HRT: enough bioidentical progesterone to avoid estrogen dominance plus low-dose estradiol. Add Genesis Gold so very low HRT doses work well and support focus and mood. Therapists have called it "therapy in a bag."

entries.title: Protect lean body mass; measure body composition
entries.deborahs_guidance: Rapid weight loss (GLP-1s, bariatric surgery) often costs 10–40% of lean mass, making you metabolically less active and set up for regain. Protein needs during weight loss are much higher than usual; supplement with whey isolate, pea or hemp protein in soups, oatmeal or smoothies when appetite is suppressed. Deborah's protein target during weight loss is 0.5–1 g per pound of lean body mass (higher end for more active people) and uses the online U.S. Navy body-fat calculator (neck, waist, hip, height, weight, age) — accurate for most people, less so for athletes. Track inches and waist, not just pounds; muscle and bone weigh more than fat.

entries.title: The hypothalamus and diabetes (new research)
entries.deborahs_guidance: A new mouse study found hypothalamic neurons (AgRP neurons) that respond to insulin and glucose; changes to them alter blood sugar. This matches what she's seen for 25 years: supporting the hypothalamus helps stabilize blood sugar, reverse insulin resistance and reduce belly fat faster. Insulin is the "key" that opens the cell to glucose, water, amino acids and fatty acids; with resistance, cells are starved and dehydrated, the pancreas overworks, and excess sugar becomes triglycerides stored around the middle (the "insulin meter"). Insulin resistance drives inflammation, hypertension, heart attack and stroke. The hypothalamic hormone POMC also regulates glucose metabolism in pancreas, liver and fat cells. Type 1 diabetes is different (autoimmune).

entries.title: What is the "second menopause," how long does it last, how is it different?

Women with strong adrenals have "easy" menopauses; today most come in with stressed adrenals, so the second menopause can arrive within 5–8 years or overlap the first. Covered in her Menopause Action Plan book.

entries.title: How to use vaginal estrogen (intercourse after menopause)
entries.deborahs_guidance: Even on systemic HRT the vagina may stay thin. Preference: compounded **estriol** (pregnancy estrogen, works fast) first; estradiol vaginal cream (standard prescription) second. Use a vaginal formulation, not skin cream. Apply with a finger rather than the applicator: estrogen receptors are in the first ~2 inches; rub it all the way around, especially the 12 o'clock position near the urethra (urinary symptoms). Like seeding a lawn: nightly at a starting dose of 2 mg per dose for 4–6 weeks, then half the amount for a few weeks, then every other night, then 1–2 times a week maintenance. She doesn't favor Premarin (conjugated equine estrogens) — the liver converts more into carcinogenic estrogen metabolites, and estrone doesn't thicken the vagina like estradiol. Vaginal estrogen is considered safe even with estrogen-related cancer history — confirm with the provider.

entries.title: Perimenopausal (43, 28-day cycles), exhausted/"adrenal insufficiency" when off GenPro — can I use it beyond the 14-day window?
entries.deborahs_guidance: Luteal-phase GenPro mimics what you should make after ovulation; in perimenopause there may be too little reserve in the first half, so the adrenals (which use progesterone to make cortisol) flag — "wired and tired." Use **half the luteal dose, once daily** (morning or night) in the first half of the cycle; if not enough, half dose twice daily. Examples: luteal 4 pumps twice daily → 2–4 pumps once daily in the follicular phase. **Take the first 3 days of the period off** (72 hours) or receptors become insensitive. Then double back up in the luteal phase. Genesis Gold helps re-regulate the HPA axis.

entries.title: Progressive muscle contraction–relaxation for night waking
entries.deborahs_guidance: Contract every muscle from toes upward — feet, calves, thighs, belly, buttocks, back, chest, shoulders, arms, hands, neck, face — squeeze and hold; then release slowly from toes up, and breathe deeply. Three waves usually brings sleep (studied in menopausal women with night waking). Burns off adrenaline and floods you with GABA.

entries.title: Healing mindset
entries.deborahs_guidance: "What you think becomes" — the hypothalamus listens to self-talk. Be your body's cheerleader and coach; notice what's working. If you can't get to a positive thought, watch, read or listen to something funny — laughter changes immune cells. Story: after a horse accident knocked out teeth in 2002 (dentist predicted they wouldn't last), she spent the weekend coaching her body to heal with every rinse, bite and dose; by Monday ER staff didn't recognize her, and she still has those teeth.
